title: 01 Register attendee
authentication: Public; no access token. Rate limited.
rules: Normalize email and validate displayName from 2 to 120 characters and password from 12 to 128 characters. Hash passwords with Argon2id. Force ATTENDEE role and create the refresh session atomically. Return 400 for invalid fields and 429 for excessive requests.

title: 02 Sign in
authentication: Public; no access token. Rate limited.
rules: Verify the password hash, active account state and credential version before issuing tokens. Use the same generic credential error for unknown email and incorrect password. Inactive accounts cannot sign in. The BFF stores tokens encrypted in its server side session.

title: 03 Browse published events
authentication: Public. No personal session is required.
parameters: Query: page=1, limit=12, city=Dhaka, category=Technology, sort=soonest. Optional search, startAfter, startBefore and maxPricePaisa.

errors.message: Page must be a positive integer.

rules: Expose only published non deleted listings and return stable pagination. Apply budget matching to currently bookable tier inventory. Discovery facts may be cached; GET /events/:slug/availability and order creation use fresh eligibility and stock checks. Private drafts are excluded.

title: 04 Create an event draft
authentication: Bearer; ORGANIZER or ADMIN. Owner is derived from the authenticated identity.

request.title: Dhaka Tech Forum 2027
request.description: A technology event with talks and workshops for the local developer community.

data.title: Dhaka Tech Forum 2027
data.description: A technology event with talks and workshops for the local developer community.

errors.message: End time must be after start time.

rules: Require a future start and an end after start. Validate title, category, location and optional HTTPS cover URL. Enforce a unique normalized slug. The client cannot assign organizerId or publish status. A created draft must go through publication readiness checks.

title: 05 Add ticket inventory
authentication: Bearer; event owning ORGANIZER or ADMIN.

errors.message: Price must be a positive integer in paisa.

rules: Validate positive integer pricePaisa and capacity and a valid sales window within event rules. The service sets reserved and sold counts. Enforce unique eventId plus name. Editing capacity must not reduce it below sold plus reserved inventory. Missing or foreign events return 404.

title: 06 Publish an event
authentication: Bearer; event owning ORGANIZER or ADMIN.

data.title: Dhaka Tech Forum 2027
data.description: A technology event with talks and workshops for the local developer community.

error.message: Event is not ready to publish

errors.message: Add an eligible unpaused ticket tier before publication.

rules: Revalidate the saved draft, future schedule and eligible saved tier in the publication transaction. PUBLICATION_NOT_READY is the service failure category and blocker details identify the cause. Do not publish from client supplied preview state. Invalidate public discovery facts after a successful change.

title: 07 Reserve tickets
parameters: No path parameters. Example request time is 2027-01-10T10:00:00Z.

errors.message: Choose a smaller quantity or another tier.

rules: Require quantity from 1 to 10. Lock and recheck current sale state and stock; use a serializable transaction to increase reservedQuantity and create the order, snapshots, audit record and idempotency result together. Same key plus same payload recovers the same order; different payload returns IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED. A 15 minute expiry is evaluated by server time.

title: 08 Start or recover checkout
authentication: Bearer; order owning ATTENDEE. Header Idempotency-Key: checkout-example-001.

errors.message: Reservation is expired cancelled or already paid.

rules: Validate order ownership, an unexpired active hold, current sale eligibility and required contact data. Persist the attempt before the provider request. A 202 PROCESSING or UNKNOWN response includes paymentAttemptId, paymentStatus and statusPath for readback; it contains no usable checkout URL. Retrying the same key must not start a duplicate financial attempt.

title: 09 Evaluate a QR admission
authentication: Bearer; event owning ORGANIZER or ADMIN.

errors.message: Provide the opaque EventGate QR token not a URL.

rules: Validate the 43 character opaque token. Check event ownership, the admission window from two hours before start through end, verified purchase and unused ticket state. Lock the order graph, atomically update the pass and write an audit record. Business rejections also use 200 with resultCode INVALID_TICKET, WRONG_EVENT, ALREADY_CHECKED_IN, WINDOW_CLOSED or ADMISSION_BLOCKED. A 200 envelope alone never admits a person.

title: 10 Request an attendee refund

request.userMessage: I can no longer attend this event.

data.userMessage: I can no longer attend this event.

error.message: This booking is not eligible for an attendee refund.

errors.message: Refund requests require at least 24 hours before the event starts.

rules: Require a paid canonical verified purchase, a published event, at least 24 hours before start and all tickets unused and ACTIVE. Reject conflicting live refunds or investigation states. Lock related financial records and create the request with audit activity. Amount and currency come from the stored purchase; the client cannot choose either. REQUESTED does not mean money has been returned.
